frequency_question: How often do central bank regulatory announcements formally satisfy the specific threshold criterion when a policy adjustment cycle occurs?
membership_rule: Members are all distinct policy action announcements by major central bank boards regarding countercyclical or macroprudential capital requirements. Excluded are informal speeches, staff working papers, and general monetary policy rate decisions not touching the specified buffer.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 named major implementation cycles; captures all instances where the substantive policy intent was formally translated into the required press release announcement mechanism.
known_gaps: Minor variations in nomenclature across central banks, though standard FOMC/Board of Governors press release structures are robustly captured.
skeleton: Global G-SIB or major jurisdiction macroprudential buffer activation events where the board officially published an increase above zero.
multiplier: 4 hits out of 4 documented major active implementation cycles in comparable jurisdictions.
validity_reason: Institutional announcement procedures and formal release mechanisms for central bank board votes remain stable over multi-year horizons.
